content.summary: Here are key facts about Aligned Data Centers: SIZE AND SCALE ** Founded in 2013 and based in Texas, the company builds and operates data centers for hyperscalers and cloud computing companies. The company has 50 data center campuses and touts roughly 5-gigawatts of contracted and available capacity. Aligned completed a capital raise of more than $12 billion in January this year, which includes $5 billion of new primary equity, comprising funds managed by Macquarie Asset Management, and more than $7 billion of new debt commitments.
